title: build(deps): bump fastapi from 0.141.1 to 0.162.4
body:
Bumps [fastapi](https://github.com/fastapi/fastapi) from 0.141.1 to 0.162.4.
Release notes

Sourced from fastapi's releases.

0.162.4

FastAPI includes an official skill that helps coding agents use new features and recommended patterns for your installed version. Install it with uvx library-skills in your project. See Develop with AI.

Fixes

  • 🐛 Require AnyIO 4.1.0 or newer at runtime. PR #16730 by @​tiangolo.

0.162.3

FastAPI includes an official skill that helps coding agents use new features and recommended patterns for your installed version. Install it with uvx library-skills in your project. See Develop with AI.

Upgrades

  • ⬆️ Add support for Python 3.15. PR #16727 by @​tiangolo.
  • ⬆️ Update locked Pydantic to 2.14.3. PR #16728 by @​tiangolo.
  • ⬆️ Upgrade markdown-include-variants to 0.0.10. PR #16705 by @​tiangolo.

Docs

  • 📝 Adopt unversioned snippets and _non_an variants. PR #16707 by @​tiangolo.
  • 🎨 Use the Zensical modern theme for docs. PR #16701 by @​tiangolo.
  • 🐛 Fix AI coding agent notice links in previews. PR #16700 by @​tiangolo.
  • 📝 Add an AI coding agent notice to the docs. PR #16699 by @​tiangolo.

Translations

  • 🌐 Update Traditional Chinese translations. PR #16719 by @​tiangolo.
  • 🌐 Update Chinese translations. PR #16718 by @​tiangolo.
  • 🌐 Update Ukrainian translations. PR #16717 by @​tiangolo.
  • 🌐 Update Turkish translations. PR #16716 by @​tiangolo.
  • 🌐 Update Russian translations. PR #16715 by @​tiangolo.
  • 🌐 Update Portuguese translations. PR #16714 by @​tiangolo.
  • 🌐 Update Korean translations. PR #16713 by @​tiangolo.
  • 🌐 Update Japanese translations. PR #16712 by @​tiangolo.
  • 🌐 Update Hindi translations. PR #16711 by @​tiangolo.
  • 🌐 Update French translations. PR #16710 by @​tiangolo.
  • 🌐 Update Spanish translations. PR #16709 by @​tiangolo.
  • 🌐 Update German translations. PR #16708 by @​tiangolo.
  • 🌐 Update Korean translations to match the English docs. PR #16706 by @​tiangolo.

Internal

  • 🔥 Remove obsolete docs snippet commands. PR #16724 by @​tiangolo.
  • 🐛 Preserve snippet variants when cleaning up docs sources. PR #16722 by @​tiangolo.

0.162.2

FastAPI includes an official skill that helps coding agents use new features and recommended patterns for your installed version. Install it with uvx library-skills in your project. See Develop with AI.

Docs

  • 📝 Add FastAPI Cloud guidance to the FastAPI skill. PR #16697 by @​tiangolo.
